rule: The input is a lattice: a background crossed by 1-wide lines through block centres, optional off-block noise and distractors, and an nr x nc array of solid k x k blocks of the block colour separated by gap rows and columns. A path of another colour is drawn in block space. The block colour is the colour of the largest solid square component. Keep exactly the rows and columns containing that colour; the blocks glue into a (k*nr) x (k*nc) output in which the path is continuous.
scope: Identify the colour of the largest solid square component, then remove intervening lattice rows and columns to reconnect a path drawn across blocks. Construct latent blocks, paths, margins and distractors independently of the solver.
constraints: All three canonical pairs reconstruct exactly;1,000 independent archived-solver checks yield1,000 distinct inputs.

known_limitations: Lattice blocks are odd-sized and centre-aligned with one-cell lines. Default sizes3/5/7/9; requested sizes11/13 are labelled extensions.
Default positive margins restrict block sizes>=9 to2x2 arrangements. Explicit zero margins permit3x3 of size9 with gap1; the source documentation was corrected accordingly.
Random paths use bounded polyline/branch/loop growth while leaving one or two blocks free. They cannot occupy a whole output row, column or block.

Distractors are judged by solid connected components, not arbitrary square subwindows inside larger rectangles. Scattered noise may attach to a planted rectangle, so an isolated rectangular component is not guaranteed.
Finite tests do not establish all feasible user-specified path/distractor combinations or benchmark-equivalent difficulty.

authored_scope: Supported: odd k from 3 to 13 (3/5/7/9 sampled by default); equal or independent row and column gaps of 1-3; arrangements of up to 7 blocks per side with at least 4 blocks, including thin 1 x n and n x 1; margins of 1..5 (0 allowed explicitly); random distinct role colours; scattered noise on background and sometimes on line cells; an optional near-miss square distractor (side 2..k-1) and an optional solid non-square rectangle distractor with area > k*k, both off the blocks; strict or relaxed paths with branches and loops. Large k (>= 9) admits only a 2x2 arrangement. Explicit latent arguments reproduce the canonical fixtures. Deliberately not supported: competing k x k squares of other colours, lines wider than 1 or not through block centres, non-square blocks, even k, and paths that fill a block or an entire output line.
authored_constraints: All role colours (block, path, background, line, noise) are pairwise distinct.
Gaps are >= 1, so every path-free block is an isolated k x k block-colour component and no gap or margin line contains the block colour.

At least one block is path-free; the path touches at least three blocks; no output row or column is fully covered by the path; no block is fully covered by the path. These are enforced for random and user strokes alike.
No colour other than the block colour forms a solid square component of area >= k*k under 4- or 8-connectivity.
Noise and distractors lie strictly off the blocks; rectangle distractors are non-square with area > k*k.
rows*cols >= 4 in every mode; the grid is at most 30x30.
Malformed arguments, infeasible layouts and deterministic stroke failures raise ValueError before any rendering.
